title: Finite spatial Lp control has a sharp mixed charge--Sobolev price

holder_sobolev_trade.lift: psi_n=Q^n phi and j_n=e Im<Q psi_n,D psi_n>=e Im<Q^(n+1)phi,D Q^n phi>
holder_sobolev_trade.sobolev: H^(sigma_p)(T3) embeds in L^(r_p)(T3) on the stated line
holder_sobolev_trade.mixed_cost: finite p requires ||Q^(n+1)phi||_(H^(3/p)); p=infinity requires only ||Q^(n+1)phi||_2 already in E_n
holder_sobolev_trade.radial_term: |integral partial_t f |psi_n|^2| <= ||partial_t f||_p ||psi_n||_(2p/(p-1))^2, controlled by H1 psi_n for p>=3
holder_sobolev_trade.boundary: the finite-p derivative loss is the charged electric-current factor in the bare Holder argument, not the radial multiplier
